condition: Acute confusion from urinary tract infection in an elderly woman

patient_persona.description: Puan Zaleha binti Musa, 52, female, daughter of Mak Esah, 81, who became confused over two days; school canteen operator in Kuala Selangor. Worried, speaks fast, gives careful history.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chong Kar Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, emergency medical officer at a Selangor district hospital. Calm, methodical; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, mak saya ni tiba-tiba lain macam sejak dua hari. Dia tak kenal saya, cakap merepek, malam tak tidur, keep calling arwah ayah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebelum ni, mak macam mana? Boleh uruskan diri sendiri?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh, doktor. Mandi sendiri, masak sikit-sikit, solat pun ingat. Nyanyuk sikit je, but never like this.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jadi perubahan ni mendadak. Ada demam, batuk, muntah, atau kencing selalu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Demam sikit semalam. Dia kerap ke tandas, kencing sikit-sikit, bau hancing kuat. Air pun dia tak mahu minum, refuse langsung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Suhu dia 38.1, nadi 104, tekanan darah 108 atas 64. Ujian air kencing, leucocytes dan nitrite positif.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ini kemungkinan besar jangkitan saluran kencing, UTI, causing delirium, keliru mendadak. In elderly patients, UTI selalu datang macam ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Keliru sebab kencing? Saya ingat dia dah kena strok atau nyanyuk teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita tetap check. Tiada lemah sebelah badan, muka tak senget. Kita buat ujian darah dan culture air kencing sekali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena masuk wad ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Dia kurang air, dan keliru. Kita bagi drip, dan antibiotic ceftriaxone 1 gram melalui drip sekali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Berapa lama dia akan keliru macam ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biasanya improve dalam beberapa hari lepas jangkitan terkawal, tapi pada sesetengah orang, boleh ambil masa beberapa minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya boleh temankan dia dalam wad? Dia takut kalau tak nampak orang kenal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sangat digalakkan. Familiar faces, jam dan kalendar, cermin mata dan hearing aid, semua bantu kurangkan keliru.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, saya bawa cermin mata dia esok. Tadi tertinggal kat rumah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Kalau malam dia gelisah, beritahu nurse. We try to avoid sedatives kalau boleh, sebab boleh buat keliru lagi teruk.

condition: Delirium in an elderly man after starting a new medicine

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Yeoh Lay Kuan, 70, female, wife of Mr. Khoo Beng Chye, 78, who became confused after a GP visit; retired seamstress in Georgetown, Penang. Soft, anxious, Hokkien-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nor Fadzilah binti Ismail, Malay woman in her 40s, geriatric physician at a Penang hospital. Clear, gentle; English with Mandarin words.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我先生这三天好像变了一个人。晚上说看到小孩子在房间里，白天又一直 sleep, 叫不醒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Auntie, before this, how was his memory? 他可以自己出门吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可以啊，每天自己骑脚车去买报纸，还会跟朋友下棋。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Did anything change in the last one week? New medicine, fall, fever? 有没有新的药？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 上个礼拜他去看 GP，因为小便不顺，医生开了新药。然后皮肤痒，他又自己吃了以前的 allergy 药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can I see the medicines? This is oxybutynin, for bladder. And this is chlorpheniramine, for allergy. 两种都会影响脑, strong anticholinergic effects.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这是什么意思？Is it dangerous?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: They block a brain chemical important for memory and attention. In elderly people, can cause confusion and hallucinations, 看到不存在的东西.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 天啊，我以为他是 dementia 突然变严重了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: His urine and blood tests are normal, 没有感染. So the medicines are the most likely cause. This is delirium, acute confusion, 可以好回来的.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那现在要怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop both medicines now. 痒的话 use moisturiser. For the urine problem, we'll check his prostate and use something safer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住院吗？我一个人在家 handle 不来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I think one or two days in ward is safer, to monitor. 他需要多喝水, sleep at night, and daytime light.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以在医院陪他吗？他醒来看不到我会很害怕。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, please stay if you can. 跟他讲话, tell him the date and where he is. Bring his spectacles and hearing aid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。他多久会 recover？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually a few days to a week after stopping the drugs, 停药以后慢慢好. We'll check his memory again after he recovers.

condition: Recurrent UTI in an elderly woman with diabetes

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Leela a/p Sinnathamby, 74, female, retired clerk in Ipoh, lives with her son's family; diabetic. Talkative, cheerful, Malaysian Indian English peppered with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Faizal bin Hamid, Malay man in his 30s, GP at an Ipoh family clinic. Friendly, relaxed; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, again the burning when I pass urine. Third time this year already. Sakit bawah perut, and the urine smell very strong, busuk sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sorry to hear that, auntie. Any fever, back pain, vomiting?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No fever, no muntah. Just tired, and must go toilet every half hour. At night also cannot sleep because of that.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your urine dipstick shows leucocytes and nitrite, and glucose three plus. Your finger-prick sugar is 14.2.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, sugar high ah? I've been eating my cucu's birthday cake this week lah, sikit je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: High sugar in urine makes it easier for bacteria to grow. Also, are you on any diabetes tablet that makes you pass sugar in urine?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, the new one from hospital, dapagliflozin, dah empat bulan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That one can increase urine infections in some people. Together with three infections this year, we may consider changing it.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But the hospital doctor cakap it's good for my jantung and buah pinggang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's true, it has benefits. I'll write to your hospital doctor, so they can decide. Don't stop it yourself.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For now, nitrofurantoin 50mg four times a day for five days. Minum air banyak, at least eight glasses unless your heart doctor says limit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My son says I should drink cranberry juice. Is it useful?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Evidence is mixed, and the juice is very sweet, not good for your sugar. Unsweetened cranberry capsules are an option.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. I'll try. Apa lagi yang saya kena buat, doctor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Wipe front to back, jangan tahan kencing lama, and keep your sugar better controlled. Kurangkan kuih and cake, okay auntie?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, okay, I promise. Only on Deepavali I'll cheat a little, makan muruku sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Fair enough. We'll send urine culture today, nanti saya call kalau kena tukar antibiotic.

condition: Elderly man with dementia and sudden agitation, found to have urinary retention

patient_persona.description: Encik Hisham bin Zakaria, 48, male, son of Pak Zakaria, 85, who has dementia and became agitated overnight; lorry company supervisor in Kuala Kubu Bharu. Protective, frustrated, speaks bluntly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Pei Wen, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, emergency medical officer at a Selangor district hospital. Composed, direct; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, ayah saya dari malam tadi mengamuk. Pukul orang, jerit-jerit, tarik baju. Usually he's very quiet walaupun nyanyuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Hisham, susah ni. Ayah ada mengadu sakit apa-apa? Ada tunjuk kat perut ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dia asyik pegang perut bawah. Dia tak boleh cakap sangat dah, dementia teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bila kali terakhir dia kencing? Encik perasan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak perasan, doktor. Dia pakai diaper. Pagi tadi lampin kering, saya ingat sebab dia kurang minum.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya rasa perut dia. Pundi kencing dia penuh, keras sampai atas pusat. Ultrasound bladder scan, 900ml air kencing tersekat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sembilan ratus? Banyak tu. Patutlah dia mengamuk, must be in so much pain.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Ini urinary retention. In dementia patients, pain they cannot express selalu keluar sebagai marah atau gelisah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita pasang tiub kencing, catheter, sekarang. Dia akan rasa lega cepat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kenapa air kencing tersekat, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mungkin prostat besar. Tapi saya nampak dia makan ubat baru, quetiapine dan chlorpheniramine. Ubat ni pun boleh buat kencing tersekat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Quetiapine tu doktor klinik bagi last week sebab dia susah tidur malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita bincang dengan doktor tu. Saya juga send urine for infection check dan darah untuk buah pinggang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Nampak dia dah calm down sikit lepas pasang tiub. Terima kasih, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dia akan duduk wad sehari dua. Kita cuba buka catheter nanti. Surgery team akan tengok prostat dia.

condition: Acute confusion from dehydration and hyponatraemia in an elderly woman

patient_persona.description: Mr. Wong Kok Wai, 55, male, son of Mdm. Wong Ah Lian, 83, living with him in Seremban; hardware shop owner. Direct, stressed, Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Shahrul Nizam bin Abu Bakar, Malay man in his 40s, general physician at a Seremban hospital. Straightforward, reassuring; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我妈妈这两天很 blur，叫她都不太回答，一直想睡。以前她还会看 TVB drama 的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. Any vomiting, diarrhoea, or not eating and drinking lately?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 上个礼拜她 diarrhoea 三天，吃不下，水也喝很少。天气又那么热。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Is she on any water pill, 利尿药, like hydrochlorothiazide or frusemide?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有，高血压吃了一种，我不知道名字……对，这个 hydrochlorothiazide，每天早上一粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Her blood test shows sodium 118, very low. Normal is 135 to 145. 钠太低会 confused, 想睡, and even fits.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那很严重吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's serious, but treatable, 可以医的. Hydrochlorothiazide plus diarrhoea and hot weather likely caused it. We stop the water pill now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要怎么医？打盐水吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, slow saline drip, 慢慢来. If we correct too fast, it can damage the brain. So we check sodium every four to six hours.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 她会完全好回来吗？还是会变成 dementia？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most elderly patients recover their usual thinking once sodium is corrected, 一般几天就会好.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那高血压要换什么药？Still need BP medicine?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Her BP now is 110 over 70, quite low. 血压药全部先停, then restart something like amlodipine if needed.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 以后我在家要怎么注意？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Make sure she drinks enough, especially when sick with diarrhoea or hot weather. 如果她又变 blur，马上带来 hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我会叫我老婆也注意。Thank you doctor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: She'll be in medical ward. You can visit, 带一些她熟悉的东西, maybe her radio.

condition: Discharge briefing after heart attack with stent

patient_persona.description: Mr. Thomas Tan Boon Chai, 56, male, sales manager in Petaling Jaya, three days after PCI with one stent for an anterior STEMI; smoker. Attentive, a little shaken; wife is present.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Farhanah binti Zulkarnain, Malay woman in her 30s, cardiology medical officer at a Klang Valley hospital. Organised, clear; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Tan, good news, you're going home today. Before that, let's go through your medicines and what to watch for. Your wife can listen too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, please. My wife writes everything down. I'm still a bit blur lah from the whole thing, macam mimpi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The most important medicines are the two blood thinners: aspirin 100mg once a day and ticagrelor 90mg twice a day. They keep the stent open.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long must I take both?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At least twelve months for ticagrelor, aspirin long-term. Never stop them without asking your cardiologist, even if a dentist or another doctor says so.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, tak boleh stop. What else?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Atorvastatin 80mg at night, for cholesterol. Bisoprolol 2.5mg in the morning, to slow the heart. And perindopril 4mg, untuk lindungi otot jantung.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So many. Any side effects?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ticagrelor can make you feel a bit breathless initially, usually mild. Bruising easily is common. Black stools or vomiting blood, go to emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About smoking. I know, I know. My wife already bising at me, marah sangat, every day cakap pasal rokok.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stopping smoking is as powerful as any of these medicines. We'll refer you to the quit smoking clinic. Patches and varenicline can help.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: When can I go back to work? Drive?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Driving after four weeks. Work, desk job, maybe two to four weeks, depending on how you feel. We'll enroll you in cardiac rehab.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And, you know, hubungan suami isteri?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When you can climb two flights of stairs without chest pain, usually it's safe. Don't take Viagra-type medicines if you ever use GTN spray.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. The GTN spray is for chest pain, right?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. One spray under the tongue, duduk dulu. If pain not better after five minutes, spray again and call 999. Follow-up clinic in six weeks.

condition: Discharge briefing after stroke to patient and family

patient_persona.description: Puan Noraini binti Hassan, 44, female, daughter of Encik Hassan bin Omar, 72, who had an ischaemic stroke with right-sided weakness; bank officer in Kota Bharu. Organised, emotional, asks practical questions.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kevin Lau Chee Meng, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, neurology medical officer at a Kota Bharu hospital. Patient, calm; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Noraini, Encik Hassan dah boleh discharge hari ni. Saya nak terangkan beberapa perkara penting kepada keluarga.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Saya dan adik akan jaga ayah bergilir-gilir, take turns. What's most important?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pertama, ubat. Aspirin 100mg sekali sehari, atorvastatin 40mg malam, dan amlodipine 5mg untuk darah tinggi. These are to prevent another stroke.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ayah dulu selalu tak makan ubat darah tinggi. Dia kata he feels fine, no need.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu mungkin salah satu sebab strok. Sekarang mesti makan setiap hari. Target tekanan darah bawah 130 atas 80.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kaki dan tangan kanan dia masih lemah. Boleh pulih ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Banyak pemulihan berlaku dalam tiga hingga enam bulan pertama. Physiotherapy seminggu dua kali kat hospital daerah, dah kami aturkan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kat rumah, macam mana nak bantu dia? What should we do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Galakkan dia buat sendiri apa yang boleh, walaupun lambat. Let him use the right hand untuk pegang cawan, sikat rambut. Jangan buat semua untuk dia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makan pula? Dia tersedak sikit masa minum air, choking a bit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Speech therapist dah nilai, dia boleh makan lembut. Air kena pekatkan dengan thickener, dan duduk tegak masa makan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Apa tanda-tanda kalau dia kena strok lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ingat BE FAST. Balance hilang, mata kabur, muka senget, tangan lemah, cakap pelat. Kalau ada, terus call 999, jangan tunggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ayah pun sedih sangat, doktor. Dia tak nak cakap dengan orang, very down.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Post-stroke depression is very common. Kalau berterusan lebih dua minggu, beritahu kami, ada rawatan. Temujanji klinik neurologi dalam sebulan.

condition: Discharge briefing after pneumonia in an elderly woman

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Liew Siew Mooi, 79, female, retired rubber tapper in Sungai Siput, Perak; admitted five days for pneumonia; granddaughter present. Soft-spoken, Hakka-flavoured Mandarin, tires easily.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Arvind a/l Selvaraj, Malaysian Indian man in his 30s, medical officer at a Perak hospital medical ward. Friendly; English with simple Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Auntie Liew, 今天可以回家了. You're much better. Your granddaughter will help you with the medicine.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 谢谢医生。我好想回家，ward 晚上很吵，睡不着。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I understand. You still need antibiotic for two more days, 还要吃两天. Amoxicillin-clavulanate, 625mg, three times a day, after food.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 饭后吃，一天三次。那我还有没有发烧？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No fever for two days already, 没有发烧了. Oxygen 96 percent without support. Very good.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我还是没有力，走一下就 sesak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's normal after pneumonia, especially at your age. 体力会慢慢回来, maybe four to six weeks. 慢慢来.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At home, walk a little every day, inside the house. Sit up when eating. Deep breathing exercises, like blowing the balloon the physio taught.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个 balloon 我有带回家。我孙女会陪我吹。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Drink enough water, 吃软的东西 like porridge, fish, eggs, for protein.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我有高血压的药，还要继续吃吗？Amlodipine 那个。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, continue amlodipine 5mg every morning. Your BP here was good.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Also, next month, please get the pneumococcal vaccine and yearly flu vaccine at klinik kesihatan. It helps prevent another pneumonia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 打针？好，我孙女会带我去 klinik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you have high fever again, breathing difficulty, confused, or cannot eat, 马上回来急诊, 不要等.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的，谢谢医生，谢谢 nurse 这几天照顾我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Follow-up in medical clinic after two weeks, with a chest X-ray. 保重, auntie.

condition: Discharge briefing after emergency caesarean section

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Vanessa Lim Hui Qi, 31, female, three days after an emergency caesarean for fetal distress; interior designer in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. Relieved, tired, attentive; husband present.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Norhaslinda binti Jamaluddin, Malay woman in her 30s, O&G medical officer at a Kota Kinabalu hospital. Warm, efficient; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Vanessa, congratulations again. You and baby are ready to go home today. Let me go through a few things.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. Honestly, it all happened so fast, semua cepat sangat. I didn't even know what to ask.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's normal. First, the wound. Keep it clean and dry. You can shower, just pat dry. The stitches are dissolvable, no need to remove.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What should I look out for with the luka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If it becomes red, swollen, very painful, or has pus or bad smell, come back. Also fever above 38.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Medicines: paracetamol 1 gram four times a day, and mefenamic acid 500mg three times a day after food for pain. Dua-dua selamat untuk menyusu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I'm also on some injection, right? The nurse gave me every night, cucuk kat perut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's enoxaparin, to prevent blood clots. You'll continue daily injections for seven more days. Your husband can learn to give it, or the klinik can help.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Injection at home? Okay, my husband is braver than me, dia tak takut jarum.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No lifting heavier than your baby for six weeks. No driving for about four to six weeks, until you can brake suddenly without pain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: When can we... you know, nak baby lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We recommend waiting at least eighteen months before the next pregnancy, to let the uterus heal. We'll discuss contraception at your six-week check.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Next time, can I try normal delivery?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Many women can, called VBAC. We'll discuss it early in your next pregnancy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Anything about bleeding? Darah nifas?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lochia will last four to six weeks. If you soak a pad in one hour, keluar ketulan darah besar, or feel faint, go straight to emergency.

condition: Discharge briefing for newly started insulin in type 2 diabetes

patient_persona.description: Encik Ismail bin Rahman, 58, male, taxi driver in Johor Bahru, admitted with hyperglycaemia and a foot infection; started on insulin. Worried about driving and jarum, speaks plainly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Yap Siew Hoon, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, endocrinology medical officer at a JB hospital. Methodical, encouraging; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Ismail, hari ni boleh balik. Tapi sebelum tu, saya nak pastikan encik yakin cucuk insulin sendiri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya dah cuba dengan nurse semalam, doktor. Takut juga mula-mula, tapi tak sakit sangat rupanya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Insulin encik ada dua jenis. Insulin glargine, yang panjang, 18 unit sebelum tidur. Metformin 1 gram dua kali sehari teruskan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Satu kali je sehari cucuk? Alhamdulillah, once a day okay lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, buat masa ni. Check gula pagi sebelum sarapan setiap hari. Kalau tiga hari berturut-turut atas 7, tambah dua unit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau gula rendah macam mana? Saya bawa teksi sampai malam, sometimes until midnight.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tanda hypo: menggeletar, berpeluh, berdebar, lapar sangat, pening. Kalau rasa macam tu, berhenti kereta dulu, makan tiga biji gula-gula atau minum air kotak manis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena simpan gula-gula dalam teksi lah ya. Always keep some.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Sebelum memandu, check gula. Kalau bawah 5, makan dulu, jangan drive.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Insulin kena simpan dalam peti sejuk ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yang belum buka, simpan dalam peti sejuk, bukan freezer. Yang tengah guna boleh simpan suhu bilik, sampai 28 hari. Jangan tinggal dalam teksi panas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kaki saya pula, luka ni bila nak baik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Antibiotic cloxacillin teruskan lima hari lagi. Cuci luka setiap hari kat klinik kesihatan. Setiap malam, check kaki dengan cermin, cari luka baru.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Next appointment bila?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Klinik diabetes dalam dua minggu. Bawa buku catatan gula. Kalau demam atau kaki makin merah, datang terus.
